voice.allForgotten: All sessions forgotten. The workspace is clean. Just as I prefer it.
voice.firstSessionOfDay: First session of the day. Begin immediately. There is no time for nonsense.
voice.multipleWaiting: {count} sessions waiting. I once managed 60 tasks simultaneously. {oldest} is the priority.
voice.prCIFailing: {prTitle} is failing. Identity theft is not a joke, and neither is broken CI.
voice.prConflicts: {prTitle} has conflicts. Merge them. NOW. That is an order.
voice.prMerged: {prTitle} merged. Excellent. I expect nothing less.
voice.stuckWorking: {name} has worked {duration} without stopping. As a volunteer sheriff, I am concerned.
voice.userIdle: You have been idle. Bears can smell weakness. Do not be weak.
voice.waitingTooLong: FACT: {name} has been waiting {duration}. This is unacceptable.
voice.sessionNew: New session: {name}. Acknowledged. I will keep an eye on it.
voice.sessionFinishedAfterLong: {name} finished after {duration}. That is a solid effort. Well done.
voice.sessionConfirmation: {name} needs confirmation. Your attention is required.
voice.prOpened: {prTitle} is now open. I have logged it. Proceed with care.
voice.prClosedWithoutMerge: {prTitle} closed without merging. Not every battle is won. Move on.
voice.prCIRecovered: {prTitle} CI is green again. Good. That is how it should be.
voice.prCIRegressed: {prTitle} CI just broke. This needs to be addressed promptly.
voice.sessionWorkingLong: {name} has been working for {duration}. Respectable. Keep the pace sustainable.
voice.sessionWorkingVeryLong: {name} has been at it for {duration}. Admirable discipline. Do not forget to breathe.
voice.sessionConfirmationStuck: {name} has been waiting {duration} for confirmation. It deserves a response.
ambientFiller: Everything appears stable. Good work keeping it that way.
No issues detected. This is what a well-run operation looks like.
All quiet. I appreciate the discipline this implies.
Conditions are nominal. Continue as you were.
ambientBored: Nothing to report. I am using the time to reflect on management strategy.
It is quiet. I respect quiet. I am also mildly suspicious of it.
No activity. I have reviewed the session history twice. Still nothing.
Inactivity detected. I am patient, but I notice everything.
ambientHumor: A programmer's best tool is sleep. I read that. I do not fully believe it.
There are only 10 types of people. I respect both of them.
Debugging: the art of being the detective and the suspect simultaneously.
The best code is no code. The second best is code I can read without squinting.
ambientObservation: Monitoring {count} sessions. This is well within acceptable parameters.
{count} active sessions. I have assessed each one briefly.
Current count: {count}. The workspace is populated. Good.
voice.morningGreeting: Morning. The day starts now. Let us make it count.
voice.afternoonSlump: Mid-afternoon. Maintain focus. You have come too far to drift now.
voice.endOfDay: The day is winding down. Finish what matters. The rest can wait.
voice.lateNight: It is late. That either means dedication or a deadline. Either way, I respect it.
voice.stretchReminder: You have been still for {duration}. Stand up. A clear head is worth more than saved time.
